nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Advanced Amazon product search and filtering powered by Nexscope data, supporting multi-dimensional criteria including category, price, monthly sales, keywords, BSR rank, review count, rating, package dimensions, weight, fulfillment type, and more. Trigger when users mention Nexscope product selection, Amazon product search, advanced product selection, BSR filtering, sales rank filtering, keyword-based product discovery, category search, competitor screening, niche product discovery, historical rank filtering, or similar terms. Even if the user does not explicitly mention "Nexscope," trigger this skill whenever the request involves multi-criteria Amazon product search, sales-metric-based filtering, or advanced product selection beyond simple keyword search.

availableDateGte.description: Product listing time range (date format: yyyy-MM-dd) (lower bound)

availableDateLte.description: Product listing time range (date format: yyyy-MM-dd) (upper bound)

buyBoxIsAmazon.description: Whether the Buy Box seller is Amazon

buyBoxIsFBA.description: Whether the Buy Box is FBA

categoriesExcludeNames.description: Subcategory names to exclude (up to 50), used when categoriesExclude is empty; the system automatically looks up corresponding category IDs. Supports full category paths for more accurate results

categoriesInclude.description: Subcategory IDs to include only (up to 50), only include products directly listed in these subcategories

categoriesIncludeNames.description: Subcategory names to include (up to 50), used when categoriesInclude is empty; the system automatically looks up corresponding category IDs. Supports full category paths (separated by : or >) for more accurate results

color.description: Color (OR match), filter products with specified colors

currentBuyBoxShippingGte.description: Current Buy Box price with shipping range (in minor currency unit) (lower bound)

currentBuyBoxShippingLte.description: Current Buy Box price with shipping range (in minor currency unit) (upper bound)

currentCountNewGte.description: Current new offer count range (lower bound)

currentCountNewLte.description: Current new offer count range (upper bound)

currentNewGte.description: Current new price range (in minor currency unit) (lower bound)

currentNewLte.description: Current new price range (in minor currency unit) (upper bound)

currentSalesGte.description: Current sales rank range (lower value = better ranking) (lower bound)

currentSalesLte.description: Current sales rank range (lower value = better ranking) (upper bound)

deltaPercent90SalesGte.description: 90-day sales rank change percentage range (lower bound)

deltaPercent90SalesLte.description: 90-day sales rank change percentage range (upper bound)

history.description: Whether to include historical data / historical sales in the response (1=include, 0=exclude, default 0)

keyword.description: Title keyword (case-insensitive; spaces mean AND tokenization; wrap keywords containing spaces in double quotes; prefix - for exclusion; & symbol is replaced with space; up to 50 keywords, max 1000 characters)

monthlySoldGte.description: Units sold / monthly sales range (lower bound)

monthlySoldLte.description: Units sold / monthly sales range (upper bound)

perPage.description: Maximum results per page (min 50, max 100, default 50)

productType.description: Product type filter (default [0,1,2]): 0=standard product, 1=downloadable product, 2=eBook, 5=variant parent ASIN

rating.description: Whether to fetch rating info (1=fetch, 0=do not fetch, default 1)

rootCategory.description: Root category IDs (up to 50), only include products in these root categories

rootCategoryNames.description: Root category names (up to 50), used when rootCategory is empty; the system automatically looks up corresponding category IDs

singleVariation.description: Return only one variation; when set to true, multi-variation products will only return one variation

size.description: Size (OR match), filter products with specified sizes

sort.description: Up to 3 sort rules, each with fieldName and sortDirection (asc or desc); supported fields: availableDate, currentSales, monthlySold, currentRating, currentCountReviews, currentBuyBoxShipping, currentNew

srAvgGte.description: Historical sales rank range (positive integer, lower value = better ranking, used for the month specified by srAvgMonth) (lower bound)

srAvgLte.description: Historical sales rank range (positive integer, lower value = better ranking, used for the month specified by srAvgMonth) (upper bound)

srAvgMonth.description: Historical sales rank - selected month (format: YYYYMM, e.g., 202511 for November 2025, within the last 36 months)

name: nexscope_amazon_product_database_search
title: Amazon Product Database Search
